elo_to_score_note: logistic Elo->win-rate then clip(2*wr); a fixed mathematical mapping, not measured.

reference_net.training: AlphaZero self-play (distributed 48xA100), sims-256 self-play, 4M replay, AdamW+cosine; net search scales strongly (+363 Elo at 512 vs 64 sims) and beats uniform-random 100%.

reachability.difficulty_basis: adversarial curation by frontier models (Fable 5.1 blue, GPT-6-Astra + Fable red, 4 rounds); their in-session self-estimate was ~0.06-0.12 with no shortcut found. This is a design-time estimate, NOT an empirical frontier-attempt result.
reachability.honesty_note: Empirical frontier self-test and from-scratch reachability run are pending; do not cite the 0.06-0.12 as a measured score.
